summary:
Submitted a research product that folds the confirmed result back into the implementation map and refocuses the frontier.

Context from the index: the checker-correspondence review was accepted, so the assessment for oblig-config-from-durable-entry is now confirmed=true, outcome=violated, reviewed_complete=true with no open review issues; pending_work is empty and the capacity still has 3 audit units and 5 semantic reviews.

Product contents (draft-relative submission.json with the updated map.json): a clarification-only map version. map_changes answers the previously open premise of behavior b-config-change instead of restating it: Raft.dispatchLogs assigns the log index and pushes the future before StoreLogs, and on a StoreLogs error answers the future and sets state Follower, while Raft.appendConfigurationEntry continues through setLatestConfiguration(configuration, future.Index()), commitment.setConfiguration and startStopReplication. The behavior keeps its owner, trigger, configuration coordinate and its edges to f-config-membership and f-commit-quorum, so impact is clarification with an explicit preserves statement and no challenge to any saved Candidate; source_ids cite SR-APPEND-CONFIG, SR-DISPATCH, SR-CONFIG-CORE and SR-NEXT-CONFIG. Its residual unknown is now the independent question of whether the unpersisted configuration can later be committed.

The accompanying feedback (ref_ids b-config-change) records the answered proposition with the measured numbers (latest_voter_count 2, latest_index 3, committed_index 1, log_last_index 2 after the injected failure on a leader that started from a single-voter, index-2 log), and carries forward the independent remaining questions: committing the phantom configuration after regaining leadership, the same publish shape on the other setLatestConfiguration callers (appendEntries truncation fallback and installSnapshot), the b-prevote, b-commit-quorum and heartbeat-fast-path unknowns.

Preflight `validate` returned valid=true with no diagnostics. Acceptance and version assignment remain with the controller.
